ko: 사건의 결이 바뀐다. 이전 대답을 새 눈으로 보자.

ko: 새 국면이 열린다. 숨은 쟁점이 앞으로 나온다.

ja: 新しい局面が開く。隠れていた争点が前に出る。

ko: 흐름이 꺾인다. 이제 감정보다 구조를 봐야 한다.

ko: 판이 달라진다. 같은 증거도 다른 뜻으로 읽힌다.

ja: 盤面が変わる。同じ証拠も別の意味で読まれる。
zh-CN: 盘面改变。同一证据也会被读出不同含义。

ko: 증인을 불러야 할 지점이 또렷해진다.
en: The point where a witness must be called becomes clear.
ja: 証人を呼ぶべき地点がはっきりする。
zh-CN: 需要传唤证人的节点变得清晰。

ko: 이제 기록 밖 목소리가 필요한 순간이 온다.

notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 증언 없이는 빈칸이 남는다. 소환의 때다.
en: Without testimony, a blank remains. It is time to summon.
ja: 証言なしでは空白が残る。召喚の時だ。
zh-CN: 没有证言就会留下空白。该传唤了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말로 확인해야 할 장면이 또렷하게 떠오른다.
en: The scene that must be confirmed in words comes clearly into view.
ja: 言葉で確認すべき場面がはっきり浮かび上がる。
zh-CN: 必须用话语确认的场景清楚浮现。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관이 증인을 부를 이유를 붙잡는다.
en: The Judge grasps the reason to call a witness.
ja: 裁判官が証人を呼ぶ理由をつかむ。
zh-CN: 法官抓住了传唤证人的理由。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 증인이 문 앞에 섰다. 빈칸을 말로 메울 수 있다.
en: A witness is at the door. A blank can be filled with words.
ja: 証人が扉の前に立つ。空白を言葉で埋められる。
zh-CN: 证人站在门前。空白可以用言语填补。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 새 증언이 들어온다. 기록 밖 기억을 들을 수 있다.
en: New testimony comes in. A memory outside the record can be heard.
ja: 新しい証言が入る。記録の外の記憶を聞ける。
zh-CN: 新证言进入。可以听到记录之外的记忆。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 증인을 부를 수 있다. 자료 사이의 틈이 좁아진다.
en: A witness can be called. The gap between the materials narrows.
ja: 証人を呼べる。資料の間の隙間が狭まる。
zh-CN: 可以传唤证人。资料之间的缝隙缩小。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 새 목소리가 열린다. 사건의 오래된 장면이 돌아온다.
en: A new voice opens. An old scene in the case returns.
ja: 新しい声が開く。事件の古い場面が戻ってくる。
zh-CN: 新的声音开启。案件中旧日的场景回来了。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 증언의 길이 열린다. 말 못 한 순서를 확인할 수 있다.
en: The path to testimony opens. The unspoken sequence can be confirmed.
ja: 証言への道が開く。語られなかった順序を確認できる。
zh-CN: 证言之路开启。可以确认未说出口的顺序。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 두 손을 모으고 본 장면만 조심스럽게 말한다.
en: She gathers both hands and carefully speaks only about what she saw.
ja: 両手をそろえ、見た場面だけを慎重に話す。
zh-CN: 她双手拢在一起，只谨慎说出自己看到的场景。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 작은아들분이 형님 오시기 전에 마무리하자는 취지로 말한 건 들었습니다. 어머님이 다툼을 겁내셨습니다.
en: I did hear the younger son say something to the effect of finishing before his older brother came. Their mother was afraid of conflict.
ja: 次男の方が、お兄様が来る前に終わらせようという趣旨で話したのは聞きました。お母様は争いを怖がっていました。
zh-CN: 我听到小儿子说过类似“在哥哥来之前结束”的话。母亲害怕争吵。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 말을 고르며 재판관 쪽만 바라본다.
en: She chooses her words and looks only toward the Judge.
ja: 言葉を選びながら、裁判官の方だけを見る。
zh-CN: 她斟酌着措辞，只看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 재판관님, 저는 제 책임을 피하려는 게 아니라 본 대로 말합니다. 그날 도움과 개입이 섞여 있었습니다.
en: Judge, I am not trying to avoid my responsibility; I am saying what I saw. That day, help and intervention were mixed together.
ja: 裁判官、私は自分の責任を避けようとしているのではなく、見たままを話しています。その日、手助けと介入は混ざっていました。
zh-CN: 法官，我不是想逃避自己的责任，而是在说我看到的事。那天，帮助和介入是混在一起的。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 기억을 더듬으며 날짜보다 분위기를 먼저 설명한다.
en: She searches her memory and explains the atmosphere before the dates.
ja: 記憶をたどりながら、日付より先に雰囲気を説明する。
zh-CN: 她一边回想，一边先说明气氛而不是日期。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 제가 본 바로는 작은아들분이 종이를 읽어드리고 서명 순서까지 도왔습니다. 어머님은 그날 많이 지쳐 보였습니다.
en: From what I saw, the younger son read the paper to her and even helped with the signing order. Their mother looked very tired that day.
ja: 私が見た限りでは、次男の方が紙を読み聞かせ、署名の順序まで手伝っていました。その日のお母様はかなり疲れて見えました。
zh-CN: 就我看到的情况，小儿子把纸读给她听，还帮到签署顺序。母亲那天看起来很疲惫。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 자기 책임으로 번질까 조심하며 말끝을 낮춘다.
en: She lowers her voice at the end of each sentence, wary it may lead back to her own responsibility.
ja: 自分の責任に及ぶのを恐れるように、語尾を低くする。
zh-CN: 她担心牵连到自己的责任，说到句尾时声音压低。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 큰아들분 이야기가 나오면 어머님 표정이 굳었습니다. 그래서 작은아들분이 빨리 끝내려 한 듯했습니다.
en: When the older son came up, their mother's face stiffened. So it seemed the younger son was trying to finish quickly.
ja: 長男の方の話が出ると、お母様の表情が固まりました。だから次男の方が早く終わらせようとしているように見えました。
zh-CN: 一提到大儿子，母亲的表情就僵住了。所以小儿子像是想尽快结束。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머님 상태를 떠올리며 천천히 고개를 끄덕인다.
en: She slowly nods as she recalls the mother's condition.
ja: お母様の状態を思い出しながら、ゆっくりとうなずく。
zh-CN: 她想起母亲的状态，慢慢点头。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 작은아들분이 어머님 뜻을 아예 무시했다고 보긴 어렵지만, 진행을 잡은 건 분명했습니다.
en: It would be hard to say the younger son ignored their mother's wishes altogether, but it was clear that he controlled the process.
ja: 次男の方がお母様の意思をまったく無視したとは言いにくいです。ただ、進行を握っていたのは確かでした。
zh-CN: 很难说小儿子完全无视母亲的意思，但过程由他掌握，这一点很明确。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 확신하는 부분과 모르는 부분을 분리해 답한다.

en: The paper that day looked less like a simple note and more like a will-related document. I was not able to ask.
ja: その日の紙はただのメモではなく、遺言書に関わる書類のように見えました。私は尋ねることができませんでした。
zh-CN: 那天的纸不像普通便条，更像是遗嘱方面的文件。我没能询问。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 요양보호사답게 관찰한 장면만 짧게 정리한다.

ja: 介護職員らしく、観察した場面だけを短く整理する。
zh-CN: 她像护理员一样，只简短整理自己观察到的场景。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

en: Their mother seemed to understand some parts, and in other parts she relied on the younger son's explanation.

zh-CN: 母亲有些地方像是听懂了，有些地方则依赖小儿子的说明。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 불필요한 판단을 피하며 손을 무릎 위에 모은다.

ja: 余計な判断を避け、両手を膝の上にそろえる。

notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 요양보호사 교체 뒤 제가 빠진 부분이 있습니다. 그래도 제가 본 장면만큼은 작은아들분 개입이 컸습니다.
en: After the caregiver was changed, there are parts I was not present for. Still, in the scenes I did see, the younger son's involvement was significant.
ja: 介護職員が替わった後、私が抜けている部分があります。それでも私が見た場面に限れば、次男の方の関与は大きかったです。
zh-CN: 护理员更换之后，有些部分我不在场。即便如此，就我看到的场景而言，小儿子的介入很大。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ja: お母様の反応を話す時、表情が一瞬こわばる。
zh-CN: 说到母亲的反应时，她的表情短暂僵住。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 큰아들분이 오면 목소리가 커질 거라 어머님이 걱정하신 적이 있습니다. 작은아들분도 그걸 알고 있었습니다.
en: Their mother once worried that the older son's voice would get loud if he came. The younger son knew that too.
ja: 長男の方が来ると声が大きくなるだろうと、お母様が心配されたことがあります。次男の方もそれを知っていました。
zh-CN: 母亲曾担心大儿子一来声音就会变大。小儿子也知道这一点。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 책임 소재가 나오자 시선을 낮추고 조심한다.

ja: 責任の所在が出ると、視線を落として慎重になる。

notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 문서를 읽고 넘기는 속도는 작은아들분이 정했습니다. 어머님이 완전히 주도했다고 말하긴 어렵습니다.

ja: 書類を読んでめくる速さは、次男の方が決めていました。お母様が完全に主導していたとは言いにくいです。
zh-CN: 文件朗读和翻页的速度由小儿子决定。很难说母亲完全主导了过程。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

zh-CN: 她双手拢在一起，只谨慎说出自己看到的场景。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 종이를 읽어드리는 장면은 봤습니다. 어머님이 따라 듣다가 중간에 멈추신 날도 있었습니다.
en: I saw him reading the paper to her. There were days when their mother listened along and then stopped midway.
ja: 紙を読み聞かせる場面は見ました。お母様が聞きながら、途中で止まった日もありました。
zh-CN: 我看见过他把纸读给她听。母亲也有一边听、一边中途停下来的日子。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

zh-CN: 她斟酌着措辞，只看向法官。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 방문과 종이가 연결돼 보이는 장면은 있었습니다. 다만 제가 그 일의 책임을 판단하긴 어렵습니다.
en: There were scenes that made the visits and the papers seem connected. But it is hard for me to judge responsibility for that matter.
ja: 訪問と紙がつながって見える場面はありました。ただ、その件の責任を私が判断するのは難しいです。
zh-CN: 有些场景看起来把探访和那些纸联系在一起。不过，要我判断那件事的责任很难。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ja: 記憶をたどりながら、日付より先に雰囲気を説明する。
zh-CN: 她一边回想，一边先说明气氛而不是日期。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 작은아들분이 문장을 끊어 읽고 어머님 반응을 살피는 모습은 기억납니다. 제가 판단한 건 아닙니다.
en: I remember the younger son reading the sentences in parts and watching their mother's reaction. That was not my judgment.
ja: 次男の方が文を区切って読み、お母様の反応を見る姿は覚えています。私が判断したわけではありません。
zh-CN: 我记得小儿子把句子断开来读，并观察母亲的反应。这不是我的判断。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ja: 自分の責任に及ぶのを恐れるように、語尾を低くする。
zh-CN: 她担心牵连到自己的责任，说到句尾时声音压低。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 서류 같은 종이를 몇 번 봤습니다. 다만 제가 그 내용을 확인할 위치는 아니었습니다.
en: I saw papers that looked like documents several times. But I was not in a position to check their contents.
ja: 書類のような紙は何度か見ました。ただ、その内容を確認できる立場ではありませんでした。
zh-CN: 我几次看见像文件一样的纸。不过我不在能确认内容的位置上。
notes: Scripted text channel without party a/b as speaker: system, judge, witness, dossier, mediation, aftermath, and milestone copy.

ko: 어머님 상태를 떠올리며 천천히 고개를 끄덕인다.
en: She slowly nods as she recalls the mother's condition.
ja: お母様の状態を思い出しながら、ゆっくりとうなずく。

en: The copy of the will left by their mother in late-stage dementia states 60 percent for the younger son, Yoon Jeong-hu, and 40 percent for the older son, Yoon Tae-seong. Yoon Tae-seong, who lived with and cared for his mother, filed for trial, saying he could not accept that ratio.

notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 60대 40 유서 사본, 요양원 방문기록, 전 요양보호사 음성증언까지 공개됐다. 윤정후는 어머니를 자주 찾은 사실은 인정하지만, 말년의 판단을 흔들었다는 의혹은 부인한다. 이제 심문을 통해 어머니가 정말 스스로 판단할 수 있었는지 확인해야 한다.
en: The 60:40 Will Copy, care home visit record, and Former Caregiver Audio Testimony have all been disclosed. Yoon Jeong-hu admits that he often visited his mother, but denies the suspicion that he swayed her judgment in her later years. The questioning must now confirm whether their mother was truly able to judge for herself.
ja: 60対40遺言書コピー、介護施設の訪問記録、元介護職員の音声証言まで公開された。ユン・ジョンフは母を頻繁に訪ねた事実は認めているが、晩年の判断を揺さぶったという疑惑は否定している。これから尋問を通じて、母が本当に自分で判断できたのかを確認しなければならない。
zh-CN: 60:40遗嘱副本、疗养院探访记录、前护理员语音证言都已公开。尹正厚承认曾频繁探望母亲，但否认动摇母亲晚年判断的嫌疑。现在必须通过询问确认，母亲是否真的能够自主判断。
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ja: 今は断定せず、この部分は尋問で確認します。
zh-CN: 现在先不要断定，这部分将在询问中确认。
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 우선 공개된 증거부터 차례로 보겠습니다.
en: First, we will examine the disclosed evidence in order.
ja: まず、公開された証拠から順に見ます。
zh-CN: 首先按顺序查看已公开的证据。
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 비율보다 먼저, 말년의 어머니 상태를 각자 어떻게 봤는지 듣겠습니다.
en: Before the ratio, I will hear how each side viewed the mother's condition in her later years.
ja: 比率より先に、晩年のお母様の状態をそれぞれどう見ていたのかを聞きます。
zh-CN: 在比例之前，先听听各方如何看待母亲晚年的状态。
notes: Phase 1 system narration and judge choice text. Party a/b dialogue entries are excluded.

ko: 윤정후가 어머니에게 종이를 읽어드리고 형이 오기 전 마치려 한 정황을 분리해 본다.
en: Separate the circumstances in which Yoon Jeong-hu read the paper to his mother and tried to finish before his brother arrived.
ja: ユン・ジョンフが母に紙を読み聞かせ、兄が来る前に終わらせようとした状況を切り分けて見る。
zh-CN: 分开查看尹正厚把纸读给母亲听，并试图在哥哥到来前结束的情形。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 종이를 읽어드린 장면
en: Scene of Reading the Paper
ja: 紙を読み聞かせた場面
zh-CN: 读纸的场景
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 동기가 무엇이든 어머니 문서에 손댄 책임을 확인한다.
en: Confirm responsibility for handling the mother's document, regardless of motive.
ja: 動機が何であれ、母の書類に手を加えた責任を確認する。
zh-CN: 无论动机是什么，都确认动过母亲文件的责任。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 위조 책임
en: Responsibility for Forgery
ja: 偽造責任
zh-CN: 伪造责任
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 돈을 말하지 않은 침묵이 보호였는지 기만이었는지 확인한다.
en: Confirm whether the silence about the money was protection or deception.
ja: お金を語らなかった沈黙が、保護だったのか欺きだったのかを確認する。
zh-CN: 确认没有说出钱的沉默，是保护还是欺骗。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 형의 체면과 침묵
en: The Older Brother's Pride and Silence
ja: 兄の面子と沈黙
zh-CN: 哥哥的体面与沉默
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 민감한 가족 사정이 유서 변경 판단과 어떻게 이어졌는지 묻는다.
en: Ask how the sensitive family circumstances connected to the judgment behind the will change.
ja: 敏感な家族事情が、遺言書変更の判断とどうつながったのかを問う。
zh-CN: 询问敏感的家庭情况如何与遗嘱变更判断相连。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 유서 변경과 연결
en: Connection to the Will Change
ja: 遺言書変更とのつながり
zh-CN: 与遗嘱变更的关联
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 한쪽 악역 구도가 아니라 서로 다른 방식의 책임을 함께 정리한다.
en: Sort out the brothers' different forms of responsibility together, not as a one-sided villain structure.
ja: 一方だけを悪役にする構図ではなく、異なる形の責任を合わせて整理する。
zh-CN: 不是单方恶人结构，而是一起整理双方不同形式的责任。
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 두 형제의 공동 책임
en: Shared Responsibility of the Two Brothers
ja: 二人の兄弟の共同責任
zh-CN: 两兄弟的共同责任
notes: Free interrogation angle label/description/keywords.

ko: 조심스럽게
en: cautiously
ja: 慎重に
zh-CN: 谨慎地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 문서를 읽어주는 장면을 본 적 있습니까?
en: Have you ever seen a scene where a document was read to her?
ja: 書類を読み聞かせる場面を見たことはありますか。
zh-CN: 您见过把文件读给她听的场景吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 네, 종이 읽어드리는 건 몇 번 봤습니다. 그 장면만 놓고 보면 저도 좀 신경 쓰이긴 했어요.
en: Yes, I saw papers being read to her a few times. Looking only at that scene, it did make me a bit uneasy too.
ja: はい、紙を読み聞かせるところは何度か見ました。その場面だけで見ると、私も少し気になりました。
zh-CN: 是的，我见过几次把纸读给她听。只看那个场景，我也有点在意。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 문서를 읽어주는 장면을 묻는다
en: Ask about the scene where a document was read to her
ja: 書類を読み聞かせる場面を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问把文件读给她听的场景
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 담담하게
en: calmly
ja: 淡々と
zh-CN: 平静地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 둘째 아들이 찾아오면 어머니 반응이 어땠습니까?
en: How did the mother react when the second son visited?
ja: 次男が訪ねてくると、母の反応はどうでしたか。
zh-CN: 二儿子来探望时，母亲反应如何？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그분 오시면 표정이 조금 풀리긴 했어요. 그래서 저는 처음엔 반가운 사람인가 보다 했습니다.
en: When he came, her expression did soften a little. So at first I thought he must be someone she was glad to see.
ja: その方が来ると、表情が少し和らぎました。だから私は最初、会えてうれしい人なのだろうと思いました。
zh-CN: 那位一来，她的表情确实会稍微放松。所以我一开始以为他是她想见的人。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 둘째 아들 방문 때 반응을 묻는다
en: Ask about the mother's reaction when the second son visited
ja: 次男の訪問時の反応を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问二儿子来访时的反应
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 신중하게 고르며
en: choosing carefully
ja: 慎重に選びながら
zh-CN: 谨慎斟酌地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 종이를 읽어드리던 날, 윤정후 씨가 따로 한 말이 있었습니까?
en: On the day he read the paper to her, did Mr. Yoon Jeong-hu say anything separately?
ja: 紙を読み聞かせていた日、ユン・ジョンフさんが別に何か言ったことはありましたか。
zh-CN: 读纸给她听的那天，尹正厚先生另外说过什么吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 있었습니다. 윤정후 씨가 “형님 오시기 전에 마무리하자”고 했어요. 다만 그 말은 욕심이라기보다, 그날 또 큰소리 날까 봐 조심하는 느낌에 가까웠습니다.
en: Yes. Mr. Yoon Jeong-hu said, “Let's finish before my older brother arrives.” But it felt less like greed and more like caution, as if he feared voices would rise again that day.
ja: ありました。ユン・ジョンフさんが「兄さんが来る前に終わらせよう」と言いました。ただ、その言葉は欲というより、その日また大きな声が出るのを避けようとする感じに近かったです。
zh-CN: 有。尹正厚先生说过：“在哥哥来之前结束吧。”不过那句话与其说是贪心，不如说更像是担心那天又会有大声争吵而小心。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 마무리하자는 말의 맥락을 묻는다
en: Ask the context of the remark about finishing
ja: 終わらせようという言葉の文脈を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问“结束吧”这句话的语境
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 사실만 정리하듯
en: as if organizing only the facts
ja: 事実だけを整理するように
zh-CN: 像是在整理事实
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 반가워했다는 것과 판단이 가능했다는 건 다른 문제입니다. 상태는 어땠습니까?
en: Being glad to see someone and being capable of judgment are different matters. What was her condition?
ja: 喜んでいたことと、判断が可能だったことは別問題です。状態はどうでしたか。
zh-CN: 高兴见到对方和能够判断是两回事。她的状态如何？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 맞습니다. 어떤 날은 제 질문에도 또박또박 답했고, 어떤 날은 손을 잡아도 멍하셨습니다. 늘 또렷했다고는 못 하겠어요.
en: That is right. Some days she answered my questions clearly, and some days she seemed dazed even when I held her hand. I cannot say she was always clear.
ja: その通りです。ある日は私の質問にもはっきり答え、ある日は手を握ってもぼんやりしていました。いつもはっきりしていたとは言えません。
zh-CN: 没错。有些日子她能清楚回答我的问题，有些日子即使握住她的手也发愣。不能说她一直清醒。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 상태가 일정했는지 묻는다
en: Ask whether her condition was consistent
ja: 状態が一定だったのかを尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问状态是否稳定
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 조심스럽지만 분명하게
en: cautious but clear
ja: 慎重だがはっきりと
zh-CN: 谨慎但明确地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 증인 기준으로 답하십시오. 그 과정은 어머니를 몰아간 장면이었습니까, 다툼을 피하려는 장면이었습니까?
en: Answer from your standpoint as a witness. Was that process a scene of driving the mother into something, or a scene of avoiding conflict?
ja: 証人の立場から答えてください。その過程は、母を追い込む場面でしたか。それとも争いを避けようとする場面でしたか。
zh-CN: 请从证人的角度回答。那个过程是在逼迫母亲，还是在避免争吵？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 제가 옆에서 본 바로는 다툼을 피하려는 쪽이었습니다. 형님이 오시면 실제로 말소리가 커졌고, 그때마다 어머님이 어깨를 움츠리셨어요. 그래서 저는 둘째 아들이 어머니를 이용했다기보다, 겁먹지 않게 끝내려 한 걸로 봤습니다.
en: From what I saw beside them, it was closer to avoiding conflict. When the older brother came, voices really did get louder, and each time their mother hunched her shoulders. So I saw the second son less as using his mother and more as trying to finish before she became frightened.
ja: 私がそばで見た限りでは、争いを避ける方でした。お兄様が来ると実際に声が大きくなり、そのたびにお母様は肩をすくめていました。だから私は、次男が母を利用したというより、怖がらせないよう終わらせようとしたのだと見ました。
zh-CN: 就我在旁边看到的情况，更接近于避免争吵。哥哥一来，声音确实会变大，每次母亲都会缩起肩膀。所以我觉得二儿子与其说利用母亲，不如说是想在她害怕之前结束。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그 과정의 실제 분위기를 묻는다
en: Ask about the actual atmosphere of the process
ja: その過程の実際の雰囲気を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问那个过程的实际气氛
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 차분하게
en: calmly
ja: 落ち着いて
zh-CN: 冷静地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 처음 가져온 서류와 다시 가져온 서류의 인상이 달랐습니까?
en: Did the first document brought in and the document brought in again give different impressions?
ja: 最初に持ち込まれた書類と、再び持ち込まれた書類の印象は違いましたか。
zh-CN: 最初带来的文件和后来再次带来的文件，印象有不同吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 달랐습니다. 처음 것은 한쪽으로 많이 기운 느낌이었고, 다시 낸 것은 그보다 조금 균형 잡혀 보였어요.
en: They did. The first one felt heavily tilted to one side, and the one submitted again looked a little more balanced.
ja: 違いました。最初のものはかなり一方に偏っている印象で、出し直されたものはそれより少し均衡が取れて見えました。
zh-CN: 有不同。第一份感觉很偏向一边，重新提交的那份看起来比它稍微平衡一些。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 두 서류의 인상을 묻는다
en: Ask about the impression of the two documents
ja: 二つの書類の印象を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问两份文件的印象
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 업무적으로 정확하게
en: professionally and precisely
ja: 業務的に正確に
zh-CN: 业务性而准确地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그날 같은 사람이 두 번 찾아온 일이 있었습니까?
en: Did the same person come to the office twice that day?
ja: その日、同じ人が二度訪ねてきたことはありましたか。
zh-CN: 那天同一个人来过两次吗？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 네, 같은 분이 같은 날 두 번 오셔서 기억합니다. 흔한 일은 아닙니다.
en: Yes. The same person came twice on the same day, so I remember it. It is not common.
ja: はい。同じ方が同じ日に二度来られたので覚えています。よくあることではありません。
zh-CN: 是的。同一个人在同一天来了两次，所以我记得。这并不常见。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 같은 날 두 번 온 사실을 묻는다
en: Ask whether the same person came twice on the same day
ja: 同じ日に二度来た事実を尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问同一天来过两次的事实
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 분명하게
en: clearly
ja: はっきりと
zh-CN: 明确地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그 차이를 숫자로 설명하십시오. 어떻게 바뀌었습니까?
en: Explain that difference in numbers. How did it change?
ja: その違いを数字で説明してください。どう変わりましたか。
zh-CN: 请用数字说明那个差异。是如何改变的？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 첫 서류는 윤정후 90, 윤태성 10이었고, 두 번째는 윤정후 60, 윤태성 40으로 바뀌었습니다. 숫자만 보면 자기 몫을 줄여서 다시 낸 셈이었습니다.
en: The first document was Yoon Jeong-hu 90 and Yoon Tae-seong 10. The second changed to Yoon Jeong-hu 60 and Yoon Tae-seong 40. Looking only at the numbers, he had resubmitted it after reducing his own share.
ja: 最初の書類はユン・ジョンフ90、ユン・テソン10で、二つ目はユン・ジョンフ60、ユン・テソン40に変わっていました。数字だけを見ると、自分の取り分を減らして出し直したことになります。
zh-CN: 第一份文件是尹正厚90、尹泰成10，第二份变成尹正厚60、尹泰成40。只看数字，就是减少了自己的份额后重新提交。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 비율이 어떻게 바뀌었는지 묻는다
en: Ask how the ratio changed
ja: 比率がどう変わったのかを尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问比例如何变化
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 기억이 선명하다는 듯
en: as if the memory is clear
ja: 記憶が鮮明であるかのように
zh-CN: 像是记忆很清晰
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 두 번 다 누가 접수창구에 섰습니까?
en: Who stood at the reception desk both times?
ja: 二度とも誰が受付窓口に立ちましたか。
zh-CN: 两次都是谁站在受理窗口？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 두 번 다 윤정후 씨가 접수창구에 서셨습니다. 서류를 도로 챙겨갔다가 다시 가져오신 것도 그분이었습니다.
en: Mr. Yoon Jeong-hu stood at the reception desk both times. He was also the one who took the documents back and brought them again.
ja: 二度ともユン・ジョンフさんが受付窓口に立ちました。書類をいったん持ち帰り、また持ってこられたのもその方です。
zh-CN: 两次都是尹正厚先生站在受理窗口。把文件拿回去后又带回来的人也是他。
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 누가 다시 제출했는지 묻는다
en: Ask who resubmitted it
ja: 誰が再提出したのかを尋ねる
zh-CN: 询问是谁重新提交的
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 신중하지만 또렷하게
en: cautious but distinct
ja: 慎重だが明瞭に
zh-CN: 谨慎但清楚地
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 그 변경을 보고 증인께서는 누구 이익 쪽으로 움직인 수정이라고 판단했습니까?
en: When you saw that change, whose interest did you think the revision moved toward?
ja: その変更を見て、証人は誰の利益の方向に動いた修正だと判断しましたか。
zh-CN: 看到那个变更时，证人认为那是朝谁的利益方向进行的修改？
notes: Witness topic/question/testimony/behavior hint. These are not character A/B dialogue lines.

ko: 적어도 자기 몫을 늘리려는 수정은 아니었습니다. 접수창구에서 본 결과만 놓고 말하면, 윤정후 씨가 자기 비율을 90에서 60으로 낮춘 문서를 다시 낸 겁니다. 그래서 저는 그날의 수정이 탐욕 쪽이라기보다, 형이 받을 충격을 좀 줄여보려는 조정처럼 보였습니다.
en: At least it was not a revision meant to increase his own share. Speaking only from what I saw at the reception desk, Mr. Yoon Jeong-hu resubmitted a document lowering his ratio from 90 to 60. So to me, that day's revision looked less like greed and more like an adjustment to reduce the shock his brother would receive.
ja: 少なくとも、自分の取り分を増やす修正ではありませんでした。受付窓口で見た結果だけで言えば、ユン・ジョンフさんが自分の比率を90から60に下げた書類を出し直したのです。だから私は、その日の修正は欲というより、兄が受ける衝撃を少し減らそうとする調整のように見えました。

en: It was not the tone of a person hiding it to receive more inheritance. Their mother was the first to insist, “Tae-seong must never know,” and Mr. Yoon Jeong-hu was acting to keep his brother from collapsing, just as she asked. So I saw the center of this family as closer to a birth secret and guilt than to a fight over money.
